abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 9. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 12.2 | 6.1 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 12.0 | 6.0 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 15.0 | 7.5 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 12.2 | 6.1 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 12.3 | 6.2 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 14.7 | 7.3 | 650 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
